# نَصْطَخِدَ (naṣṭaḵida) /nasˤ.tˤa.xi.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِصْطَخَدَ (iṣṭaḵada)
# نُصْطَخَدَ (nuṣṭaḵada) /nusˤ.tˤa.
